workspace.text:

infeasible.reason: After checking all four partners' calendars, there is no 30-minute time slot during the week of November 16-20, 2026 (9:00 AM - 5:00 PM Eastern) when all four partners (Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor) are available.
